reader_question: Which national park draws the most visits?
grade_line: Documented: the National Park Service’s visitor counts
title: Great Smoky Mountains National Park drew 11.5 million recreation visits in 2025, the most of the 63 national parks and more than twice Zion’s 5.0 million.
measure_line: Recreation visits to the 12 most visited of the 63 national parks, in millions, 2025, United States
source_line: Source: National Park Service, Visitor Use Statistics (IRMA), recreation visits, 2025, the 12 most visited of the 63 national parks, United States. Retrieved November 12, 2026. A count of visits, not of separate people; national parks only, not the Service’s other sites.
alt: Bars of 2025 recreation visits to the 12 most visited national parks, Great Smoky Mountains’ 11.5 million in red and the rest in gray, from 5.0 million at Zion down to 2.9 million at Joshua Tree.

table.caption: Recreation visits to the 12 most visited national parks, 2025
